title: Flying Manor - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Flying Manor in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: A floating manor reached with Esquie. It is the source of Gesam, Seashellum and Martenon, and hosts one of the Chromatic Glissando fights.

sections.title: How to Reach Flying Manor
sections.content: Requires Esquie's flight. Located above The Continent.
